clue.text: Inquest to sort out results of division

indicators.note: to sort out a jumble is to rearrange it, so the letters of the two words before it are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A coroner's inquest is asked to settle what came of a split.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sort out' rearranges INQUESTTO, the letters of 'Inquest to'.
explanation.definitionFit: A quotient is the number obtained when one quantity is divided by another, so these are the results of division.

definitions.meaning: a rank is a line of people or taxis waiting in order
a pigtail of hair worn hanging at the back, especially in eighteenth-century fashion

explanation.walkthrough: Taxi rank is British for the line of cabs waiting for fares.
explanation.definitionFit: A line of people waiting is one sense; a plaited pigtail is the old other sense of the same word.

clue.text: Where office work is seen to be done

definitions.text: Where office work is seen to be done

parts.words: Where office work is seen to be done
parts.note: 'done' means finished rather than performed: the tray on a desk where completed papers sit waiting to be collected

explanation.definitionFit: The desk tray holding finished papers is where completed work visibly ends up.

parts.note: a conception is a notion or idea
L is the Roman numeral for fifty, taken as 'many'

explanation.surface: Many people regard a certain conception as spotless, an echo of the Immaculate Conception.
explanation.walkthrough: 'find' is a link. 'Conception' and 'immaculate' together suggest the religious doctrine, but they are split between wordplay and definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something perfect, without any flaw, is what is ideal.

clue.text: People going to court may catch it!

definitions.text: People going to court may catch it!

parts.words: People going to court may catch it!
parts.note: the court is a tennis court, not a law court: players may see the ball clip the top of the net

explanation.definitionFit: In tennis, a ball touching the top band of the net is said to hit this, which players on court may catch.

clue.text: It is provided in important cup match

indicators.note: in shows one word placed inside another

parts.note: seminal means highly influential, important
if means provided that

explanation.surface: Something is supplied for a big cup game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It is' is a link phrase leading into the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A semi-final is the cup tie played to decide who reaches the final.

clue.text: Land set back by a lake

indicators.note: set back means the word for the land is written backwards

parts.note: Eire is the Irish name for Ireland, a land

explanation.surface: Some country sits beside a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: Erie is one of the Great Lakes of North America.

indicators.note: a form of something is a new shape of it, so the letters of General are reshaped

explanation.surface: A military commander shapes a kind of growth.
explanation.definitionFit: To enlarge something is to make it bigger, to increase it.

clue.text: Units seen in one Eastern country or another

indicators.note: seen in shows the units placed within the country's name

parts.note: India is an Eastern country
units are ones

explanation.surface: Units turn up in one country of the East or perhaps a different one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'or' is a link; 'another' is another Eastern country.
explanation.definitionFit: Indonesia is a second Asian country, so the answer names another such nation beside India.

indicators.note: crashes suggests wreckage, so the letters of the two words before it are smashed into a new order

explanation.surface: A motorist's slogan: with this, we can defeat car crashes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crashes' rearranges LETSBEAT, the letters of 'Let's beat'; the whole clue also describes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A car's safety strap is the device with which drivers beat the effects of crashes.

parts.note: MA, Master of Arts, is a qualified graduate
a lady is a woman

explanation.surface: A grievance is raised by a woman with a degree.
explanation.definitionFit: A complaint in the medical sense is an illness, a malady.

parts.note: not a well-mannered train driver but a refined fuel that powers an engine

explanation.definitionFit: Car fuel is refined from crude oil and drives the engine.

indicators.note: in puts the strong mark inside the reworked letters
parts, as a verb, splits things up, so the letters of foreign are separated and rearranged

parts.note: f, forte, is the musical marking for strong or loud

explanation.surface: A sacrifice is made, strong in faraway lands.
explanation.walkthrough: 'parts' rearranges FOREIGN to OFERING, and 'in' places F inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: An offering is something given up to a god, a sacrifice.

clue.text: He may make or interpret a score

definitions.text: He may make or interpret a score

parts.words: He may make or interpret a score
parts.note: the score is both points in a game and a musical score: a sportsman scores, a musician performs written music

explanation.definitionFit: A sportsperson piles up points and a musician performs written music, both called by this one word.

parts.note: lief is an old word meaning gladly, willingly
to permit is to allow

explanation.surface: Gladly let someone stay idle.
explanation.definitionFit: Land that lies fallow is left unplanted and idle, inactive for a season.

indicators.note: renovation rebuilds something, so the letters of the words before are rebuilt

explanation.surface: A railway terminus is thought to want doing up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'needs renovation' rearranges ATERMINUS, the letters of 'a terminus'.
explanation.definitionFit: To ruminate is to ponder deeply, so ruminates means considers.

indicators.note: possibly says the letters might be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A performer who might come from Sudan.
explanation.definitionFit: A danseuse is a female ballet dancer, a stage entertainer.

clue.text: Shaped up again — to a more moral life?

definitions.meaning: made into a shape a second time
describes a sinner who has turned over a new leaf

explanation.definitionFit: Re-formed is shaped once more; a person brought back to better conduct is also described this way.

parts.note: O, the figure zero, is nothing

indicators.note: holds says one word contains the other

parts.note: minus means less
O again stands for nothing

explanation.surface: A sinister note: zero with less inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Ominous describes something that seems to threaten trouble ahead.

clue.text: Set free but abused in return

indicators.note: in return means the word for abused is turned round

parts.note: reviled means abused verbally

explanation.surface: Someone released, but insulted in exchange.
explanation.definitionFit: To deliver someone is to rescue or set them free.

clue.text: A trail possibly taken to rodeo by cowboy

indicators.note: possibly says the letters might be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A cowboy brings a track to the rodeo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges ATRAIL, the letters of 'A trail'.
explanation.definitionFit: A lariat is a rope lasso, the thing a cowboy takes to a rodeo.

clue.text: Had a series of strokes but recovered

definitions.meaning: in tennis, players exchange a series of shots in a rally

explanation.surface: Someone suffered several strokes yet pulled through.
explanation.definitionFit: Tennis players exchanged a long sequence of shots, and a patient got better: the same verb serves both.

indicators.note: a composition is a putting together, so the letters following are rearranged

explanation.surface: A schoolchild's essay about a Latin topic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Composition' rearranges ONALATIN, the letters of 'on a Latin'.
explanation.definitionFit: A national of a country is a citizen, one of its subjects.

indicators.note: trouble stirs things up, so the letters of fiscal are disturbed

explanation.surface: Religious leaders find themselves in money difficulties.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trouble' rearranges the letters of 'fiscal'; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Califs, or caliphs, were the religious and civil heads of Islam.

indicators.note: in shows the number placed within the word for custody

parts.note: care, as in taken into care, is custody
V is the Roman numeral five, a number

explanation.surface: A number of prisoners held is reduced.
explanation.definitionFit: To carve is to cut, as with a joint of meat or wood.

clue.text: Gift is just about a pound

indicators.note: about shows the word for just placed around the other letter

parts.note: fair means just
L is the abbreviation for a pound sterling, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: A present costs only about a pound.
explanation.walkthrough: 'just' looks like 'merely' but means fair; 'is' and 'a' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: A flair is a natural gift or talent for something.

definitions.meaning: everyone on strike, so no one is at work

explanation.definitionFit: When a union calls every member out on strike no one works; going flat out means the full effort.

definitions.meaning: a small keyboard instrument of the harpsichord family, popular in Tudor times

explanation.definitionFit: An early keyboard instrument shares its name with the adjective for pristine or chaste.

clue.text: Wild swan seen in a field of barley

definitions.text: seen in a field of barley

indicators.note: wild suggests disorder, so the letters of swan run loose

explanation.surface: An untamed swan is spotted in a barley field.
explanation.definitionFit: Awns are the bristles on ears of barley, visible across a field of it.

parts.note: sur is French for on
to render is to give back, return

explanation.surface: Quit on account of a French reply.
explanation.definitionFit: To surrender is to yield, to give up.
